title: [MWB] Once running in service mode the file transfering function will not work

status.label: Needs focused investigation
status.detail: Mouse Without Borders file clipboard transfers reportedly fail when the sending machine uses service mode.

next_action.label: Reproduce and review proposal
next_action.reason: The current clipboard path checks transfer settings and impersonates the logged-on user to examine a file, but the actual failed boundary in this old service-mode report remains unconfirmed.

A separate 2024 commenter reports persistence; issue #51077 aggregates this report with other clipboard cases.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the reported behavior and review the scoped proposal before implementation.

fix_assessment.rationale: The current clipboard path checks transfer settings and impersonates the logged-on user to examine a file, but the actual failed boundary in this old service-mode report remains unconfirmed.

proposed_fixes.title: Restore file clipboard transfer in service mode
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: the service-mode sender or its logged-on-user helper fails to publish the file clipboard event; the reported stopped service is not proven to be the cause.
plan: Reproduce the two-machine normal/service-mode matrix with a small disposable file.
Trace clipboard notification, helper connection, impersonated file access, and transfer initiation at the failing sender.
Fix the verified boundary and add regression coverage for both transfer directions and normal mode.
verification: File clipboard transfers succeed in both directions with either machine in service mode without regressing text clipboard sharing.

reproduce.title: Restore file clipboard transfer in service mode
reproduce.version_requirement: Reported build and current PowerToys build
prerequisites: Two paired Windows test machines on a trusted network
Mouse Without Borders clipboard sharing and file transfer enabled
setup: Create a small non-sensitive disposable file and confirm transfer with both machines in normal mode.
steps: Switch only the sender to service mode and restart the module as described.
Copy the test file and paste it on the other machine; repeat in the opposite direction.
Compare text clipboard transfer and actual service/helper state.
reproduce.expected_result: File and text clipboard transfers succeed in each direction across normal and service modes.
